description: Epic-level question about adding observability to the dogfood test harness. Track: (1) all messages between orchestrator and sub-agents, (2) all messages between orchestrator and simulated human, (3) tool calls from any agent/sub-agent, (4) context usage per agent to ensure no compaction and ideally staying below 40% of 1M context window. This goes beyond the basic cost/stats tracking already in the harness. May be a separate slice or side quest.
droppedReason: Raw stream transcript file serves as the instrumentation layer — simulated user reads it for context, and it captures all messages/tool-calls/sub-agent output for observability
name: harness-observability-instrumentation
